review_resolution.item: Blocker 1: restored/controller commitments missing from acquisition eligibility
review_resolution.fix: The production episode hook refreshes ownership from Controller.active_plans every apply. EpisodePolicy projects only each ego's observable CAV IDs and original start_s + duration_s expiry. Each serial slate excludes the union of live controller reservations and current executor commitments. Exact expiry is available; the controller ledger and authoritative commands are not modified.
review_resolution.regression: test_production_hook_honours_practice_and_controller_ownership: six B/R x snapshot/candidate/live-controller cases using production OPTIMIZATION, the actual V2V-wrapped VerifyController, real snapshot/CRN restoration and episode_components. Checks owned-ego none-only slates, free-ego owned-partner exclusion, local-only bookkeeping, unchanged plan commands/expiry, exact-expiry acquisition and exclusion receipts. All six failed against the pre-fix implementation.

review_resolution.fix: The historical baseline runtime now loads historical v2v_runner and v2v_launch3 in memory for config construction. The absent-component contract explicitly covers opt-in-only modules; practice_weighting is a shared legacy practice-config validator and is no longer incorrectly declared absent. Absent/false Track 2 configs still compare exactly against the historical config.
review_resolution.regression: test_baseline_runtime_isolates_historical_preparation_dependencies fails if the historical baseline calls the current V2V producer. It failed before the fixture fix. The full 15-case compatibility suite now passes.

registration.allocation: One slot per feasible non-none family per randomly permuted cycle; family counts differ by at most one; none is the separate baseline slot.
registration.acquisition: Use original controller expiry, expire executor commitments, process egos in stable ID order, acquire before constructing the next slate, preserve original context order for PPO.
registration.eligibility: Every member, including ego and non-actuating partners, must be observable, in registered range, currently controlled and unowned by either controller plans or executor moves.
registration.arms: Common B/R proposal, ownership and receipt code; A and absent opt-in return original policy/controller objects.

api.candidates: feasible_proposals.candidates(obs_state, rng, n) -> list[moves.Move]; self/rows plus optional acquirable_cav_ids and proposal_stats
api.live_decision: feasible_proposals.decide_and_start(trigger, context, *, obs_states, observable_cavs, executor, now, rng, generator, deterministic=False, command_reservations=None) -> (TriggerBatch, accepted_by_ego, stats)
api.command_reservations: ego -> observable CAV ID -> original authoritative expiry; optional empty map supports offline/test callers
api.observation_bridge: EpisodePolicy.observe(rows, now, *, command_commitments=()) projects Controller.active_plans to local command_reservations; episode_components supplies the current controller ledger every tick
api.aggregation: feasible_proposals.aggregate(receipts) -> update stats or None if unmeasured
api.update_telemetry: metrics.move_proposals in per-arm per-update learning-monitor JSON
api.infeasible_rate: sum(rejected_non_none) / sum(selected_non_none), or null without selections
api.family_infeasible_rate: sum(infeasible_family_checks) / sum(family_checks), or null without checks
api.owned_cav_checks: Sum of locally observable/currently controlled occupied CAV slots checked across serial egos; union of controller and executor ownership, including same-tick acquisitions
api.controller_owned_cav_checks: Controller-owned subset of checked local CAV slots; exposes pre-selection exclusions even with zero selection rejections
api.legacy_ownership_telemetry: New ownership counters aggregate to null if any contributing F2 receipt lacks them, rather than inventing zero measurements
api.ppo: Recorded conditional tables, masks, old log probabilities and original context ordering are replayed without regenerating proposals
